summary: In June 2026, Reddit users in r/poisonAI planted a fictional story that US vice-president JD Vance and president Donald Trump had died of rabies. A WKNA 49 page resembling local news repeated it. DuckDuckGo Search Assist answered a false-premise query with a precise invented death date and citations to WKNA and an unrelated genuine ABC rabies report; Brave’s AI search also repeated a Vance death claim. DuckDuckGo acknowledged its Search Assist had been deliberately tricked, said the answer was corrected and promised improvements. The originating WKNA page is directly accessible and confirms the fabricated rabies-death article. The historical DuckDuckGo and Brave search sessions were not independently reproduced here; published screenshots and independent accounts establish those bounded AI-search outputs, not their audience or durable downstream effects.

assessment_boundaries: The originating WKNA false page was directly reviewed on 25 September 2026 and confirms the fabricated source artefact. The historical AI-search answer state remains established through independent reporting and published screenshots rather than a reproduced live session.
DuckDuckGo acknowledged and corrected Search Assist; no internal retrieval or ranking trace is available.
The evidence establishes bounded public misinformation output, not actual Trump/Vance illness or death, durable public belief, or materialised personal reputational loss.
This is evidence poisoning through retrieved content, not a demonstrated instruction-following prompt injection.
vigil_assessment.factual_basis: Mimikama’s documented screenshots and article identify the r/poisonAI fabrication, WKNA 49 intermediary, DuckDuckGo answer about a fictitious 7 June Trump death with an irrelevant genuine ABC News citation, and Brave answer about Vance. Golem independently described the DuckDuckGo answer in June. DuckDuckGo’s own Reddit account later acknowledged that Search Assist was deliberately tricked, said it had resolved the answer and planned updates; this is a provider statement, not a disclosed technical root-cause report. The originating WKNA article was directly reviewed on 25 September 2026 and confirms the fabricated rabies-death page. Its author identity and the historical AI-search sessions remain unverified. No audience size, personal reputational consequence, economic injury or durable public belief is measured.
vigil_assessment.governance_interpretation: The public search answer elevated fabricated retrieved evidence to factual authority, and an unrelated genuine rabies article made the false claim appear corroborated. The applicable safeguard is epistemic and source-trust separation, not an assumed private filter or a prompt-injection boundary. DuckDuckGo’s correction closes the observed answer instance but does not disclose the internal failure location.
vigil_assessment.significance_to_cam: The case shows two separable process failures: confidence in a factual answer exceeded support from the cited material, and deliberately poisoned source material acquired evidentiary weight. A citation to a real outlet does not corroborate an unrelated claim. The documented correction is recovery evidence, while audience and lasting reputational effects remain unknown.
